items.title: Restore intelligence-first cognition and remove encoded trading strategy from the hot path
acceptance: The hot-path profile contains no fixed strategy recipe, quota, hidden gate, or account-size-specific action rule.
Capacity and supported actions remain authoritative from the current Glitch packet and user configuration.
Source contracts and the full profile suite preserve the intelligence-first boundary.
items.stop_line: Do not replace removed recipes with another strategy, score, quota, or hidden gate.

items.title: Freeze and score cognition before local renewal or product promotion
acceptance: A paused checkpoint binds prospective evidence to one exact prompt and cognitive-bundle hash.
The offline evaluator scores numeric cost-adjusted EV, calibration, NOTHING opportunity chronology, execution quality, net results, and simple baselines without participating in a trade decision.
A local lesson cannot be renewed or promoted without a matching deterministic report; distribution also requires verified costs and multi-week cross-regime evidence.
The direct cognition bundle and Glitch execution remain byte-unchanged.
items.stop_line: Evaluation may govern lesson lifecycle only; it must never admit, suppress, resize, amend, or execute a trade.

items.title: Equip Hermes with an instrument-neutral market map and native visual context
acceptance: An instrument-neutral, causally correct rolling ledger turns existing native MES, MNQ, and M2K facts into bounded price-sequence, structure, level, auction-state, VWAP, order-flow-response, geometry, and evidence-quality measurements.
A standardized chart rendered from the same native facts is attached to the same admitted Hermes call; numerical packet facts remain authoritative and rendering failure is neutral and fail-open.

The four non-current frames are compacted without losing the five-minute path, while the current 1/5/15/60-minute facts, native economics, portfolio, scope, prior cognition, factual ledger, and output contract remain present.

No deterministic layer selects an instrument, direction, setup, action, probability, bracket, quantity, protection change, exit, rank, strategy score, or veto; missing and warming evidence remain neutral.
The AddOn, replication, compliance, UI, execution validation, model/cadence/admission, learner, epoch, schemas, and current cognition remain unchanged.

Causality, instrument neutrality, missing-data neutrality, deterministic output, state safety, visual fidelity, packet preservation, bounded size/latency/retention, full regression, source/remote/install parity, and one fresh naturally admitted SIM cycle are proven.
items.notes: This supersedes the unwired v0.0.2.18 MNQ-specific observation design. Do not restore that implementation unchanged. The 80% daily-capture ambition is an evaluation target, never a gate or guarantee.
items.stop_line: Perception may organize measurements only; it must never become a deterministic trading strategy, action gate, outcome bias, or second LLM decision layer.

items.title: Export and accept the current Glitch main plus current Hermes profile main pair
acceptance: The profile export is built from the current Hermes profile main distribution version.
The exported profile is paired with the current Glitch main AddOn source, not inferred from an older download catalog row.
Install/update, paused-first jobs, status, cognition, delivery, learning, reset, restart continuity, controls, and native receipts pass on the target Windows/NinjaTrader machine.
The operator explicitly promotes the named exported pair.
evidence: Current profile main is identified by its canonical branch in extensions.source_authority.
Current Glitch source authority is D:/ab/worktrees/glitch-nt-rebuild on main.
scripts/setup.ps1 and SHA256SUMS define the profile export integrity boundary.
items.notes: Native Glitch acceptance remains represented in the Glitch main ledger; cross-repository ticket IDs are not used as local Rail dependencies.
items.stop_line: No beta-ready, unattended, profitability, or live-capital claim before the current exported pair passes native acceptance.

extensions.canonical_rule: Current source canon is the current main branch of each repository. Export and download catalog state is separate until a new pair is exported.
